long_description:
The South Asian Collective invites you to a night of nostalgia, beat-dropping tracks, and vibrant lights at our 90s Bollywood Diwali!

Whether you were busy watching DDLJ for the 5th time or executing flawless Bhangra moves, this is your time to shine. Dust off your most glamorous retro-inspired outfits and get ready to dance the night away.

Event Highlights

The Vibe: Pure 90s nostalgia—think classic cassette tapes, marquee lights, iconic photo ops, and high-energy Bollywood beats all night by DNA Events! 

The Feast: Delicious food and festive treats hosted at Mint Restaurant.

The Fun: Mehndi by Prisha’s, activities for kids, dance performances galore, open bar for adults, and everything in between!

The Dress Code: Fabulous & Festive —channel your favorite 90s screen icon or bring out your boldest Diwali glam!

Ticket Information:

Adults (18+): $100

Kids (5–17): $75

Kids Under 5: Free

RSVP via Evite only & payment via Zelle as indicated on the invite. Your spot is not confirmed until we receive payment

Please indicate number of adults and children in your RSVP. https://evite.me/kQagZArhtN 

Also check out other Kids events & activities in Garden City.
